<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_skill.rs. Edit this template and its shared references. -->

Review an existing note using the checklist and report format below. Request
missing note or source locations when needed. When reviewing directly, apply the
prompt instructions yourself; when preparing a reviewer handoff, fill its placeholders.

This review is read-only: do not edit files, run shell commands or tests, execute
project code, install software, or write to external services. Use read-only file
and source readers; report inaccessible evidence as unverified. Do not draft or
convert a page as part of this skill.
